newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion buys German sale right from Nycomed.
newsitem.headline: Orion buys German sale right from Nycomed.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had acquired from Nycomed Arzneimittel GmbH, part of Norwegian Nycomed ASA, the right to sell 50 drugs in Germany.

"The agreement comprises sales authorisations for 50 products in Germany, including the related trademarks. Part of the products have not been commercialised yet. The agreement covers the products only, no other assets or liabilities, nor personnel are included in the transaction," Orion said.
Annual net sales of the acquired products were nine million German marks in 1996, it said.
Net sales of the group's German subsidiary Orion Pharma GmbH totalled 53 million German marks last year.
"The agreement is not expected to have any significant impact on Orion's results during the next two years," it said.
